info.name: Oracle Financials General Ledger Budgetary Control Ledger Balances API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip before returning results

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

params.name: q
params.description: Filter expression using Oracle REST query syntax

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by, with optional asc or desc

params.name: finder
params.description: Named finder to execute a predefined query

items.docs: Retrieve balance amounts for account combinations or accounts defined as part of an account group. Supports filtering by ledger, period, account segment values, and balance type.
